blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDKG has no cross-chain bridge: it is a standalone Tether-style token issued and burned natively on each chain by the issuer (Gold Dollar / OJSC Virtual Asset Issuer) via issue()/redeem() functions, with separate, non-identical contract addresses on Ethereum (0xe820...45e3) and Tron (TXZo12...nwEG). Supply on each chain is independently issuer-minted against gold reserves with no cross-chain dependency, so the route is single-chain-or-native rather than opaque.
